card.text: Young dwarf twin of VHS 1256-1257 A, swinging around it every 7.3 years on a very eccentric orbit.

introduction.text: VHS 1256-1257 B and its twin A are near-identical dwarfs. Their orbit is the most eccentric yet measured for so small a pair.

sources.label: Dupuy et al. 2023
sources.quote: the highest ever measured for a very low-mass binary

color.title: Photosphere colour
color.summary: A blackbody at the star's published temperature. No surface picture exists.
